title: Lesson 9
paragraph: 道順と身近な時間表現

words.meaning: to stay until someone arrives or something happens
words.example: Please wait for me outside the shop.

words.meaning: to go from one side of a road to the other
words.example: Hold my hand when we cross the street.

sentencePractice.prompt: The shop is on the opposite side of this road. Use the crossing to ____ and reach it.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: A crossing takes a pedestrian from one road side to the other. Walking along the road or around a corner does not cross this road.

words.meaning: at the place where two streets meet
words.example: There is a small bakery at the corner.

words.meaning: on the opposite side from someone or something
words.example: The library is across from the park.
words.usageNote: 間に道などを挟んで向かい側にある位置。next to（隣）とは区別します。

words.meaning: during a journey to a place
words.example: We bought some bread on the way home.

words.meaning: a long distance away from a place
words.example: Our house is far from the station.
words.usageNote: ここでは物理的な距離が遠い意味です。

words.meaning: during the time when it is dark outside
words.example: You can see many stars at night.

words.meaning: during the first part of the day before noon
words.example: I water the plants in the morning.

words.meaning: one time in every seven days
words.example: We have an art lesson once a week.

sentencePractice.prompt: My only swimming lesson each week is on Monday, so I have a swimming lesson ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: There is explicitly only one lesson in each seven-day period. Neither seven daily lessons nor two weekly lessons matches that count.

words.meaning: on an occasion when you have never done something before
words.example: I rode a horse for the first time yesterday.
